review_candidates.title: Finsktalande IT Service Desk-medarbetare till Synsam
review_candidates.description: Är du finsktalande, gillar du teknik, problemlösning och att hjälpa människor? Har du erfarenhet av IT-support och trivs i en roll där service, samarbete och ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt står i centrum? Då kan du vara vår nästa kollega på Synsam! På Synsam är våra medarbetare en viktig del av kundupplevelsen. För att våra butiker och huvudkontor ska kunna leverera service i världsklass behöver även tekniken fungera smidigt i vardagen. Därför spelar vår IT Service Desk en viktig roll i organisationen. Nu söker vi en engagerad och serviceinriktad finsktalande kollega som vill bli en del av vårt nordiska IT Service Desk-team. Här får du arbeta nära verksamheten, hjälpa kollegor med både stora och små tekniska utmaningar och bidra till att skapa en enklare IT-vardag för våra medarbetare, främst i Finland men även runt om i övriga Norden. Om rollen I rollen som IT Service Desk-medarbetare är du en viktig kontakt för våra butiker och huvudkontor. Du ansvarar för att ta emot, registrera, felsöka och lösa inkommande IT-ärenden. Det kan handla om allt från enklare användarfrågor till mer avancerade tekniska problem där du behöver tänka ett extra varv för att hitta rätt lösning. Du arbetar i en Windowsmiljö med Microsoftprodukter och våra egenutvecklade butikssystem Optisys och Eyelife. Arbetet sker både via telefon, mail och genom On-site-support, vilket innebär att du ibland hjälper användare direkt på plats. I Dina Arbetsuppgifter Ingår Bland Annat Att Ta emot, prioritera och hantera inkommande IT-ärenden från våra butiker och huvudkontor. Felsöka och lösa tekniska problem samt vägleda användare i olika IT-frågor. Ge support via telefon och vid behov hjälpa användare på plats. Dokumentera ärenden och lösningar för att bidra till ett effektivt arbetssätt och en gemensam kunskapsbank. Samarbeta med kollegor inom IT och övriga delar av organisationen för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare får bästa möjliga support. Vem är du? Du talar finska flytande och vi tror att du är en person som tycker om att hjälpa andra, har ett genuint intresse för IT och teknik och motiveras av att hitta lösningar på tekniska utmaningar. Du är serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och har ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt. När ett problem dyker upp ser du möjligheter snarare än hinder och du trivs med att hitta lösningar som fungerar för användaren. Du är strukturerad och ansvarstagande, samtidigt som du har förmågan att prioritera när flera ärenden kommer in samtidigt. Du uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till en positiv laganda. Erfarenhet och kunskap För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har: 1–2 års erfarenhet av IT-support eller en liknande supportfunktion. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med nordisk IT-support. Erfarenhet av On-site-support och att hjälpa användare på plats. Vana vid att hantera supportärenden via telefon & mail och känner dig trygg i den typen av kontakt. Mycket goda kunskaper i finska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Meriterande om du även talar & skriver svenska. God teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av felsökning och problemlösning. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från retail eller annan butiksverksamhet, gärna i en organisation med många butiker och användare. Har du dessutom erfarenhet av Synsam och våra butikssystem Optisys och Eyelife ser vi det som ett extra plus. Om tjänsten Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placering på vårt huvudkontor i centrala Stockholm. Arbetstiderna är förlagda enligt tvåskift, där du arbetar antingen 08.30–17.00 eller 09.30–18.00. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Rekryteringen sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag – så vänta inte! 🚀Observera att vi ej tar emot ansökningar via e-post. I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt bakgrundskontroll avseende brott och ekonomi på slutkandidat. För anställning krävs att du har giltig rätt att arbeta i Sverige i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning. Vi på Synsam söker engagerade och talangfulla personer i alla åldrar! Hos oss värdesätts mångfald och vi tror att olika perspektiv och erfarenheter berikar vårt arbete och bidrar till vår gemensamma framgång. Hoppas vi ses – ta chansen att bli vår nästa IT-kollega! 🌟

review_candidates.title: Director of People & Culture - Four Seasons Hotel Luxor, Egypt
review_candidates.description: About Four Seasons Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: Perched along the banks of the Nile in the heart of Egypt's legendary ancient city of Thebes, Four Seasons Hotel Luxor will bring world-class hospitality to one of the world's most remarkable destinations. Set to open in 2027, the hotel will feature 200 guest rooms and suites with views of the Nile, exceptional dining experiences, a luxurious spa and wellness offering, family-focused amenities, and event spaces. Located moments from the iconic Luxor Temple and the Valley of the Kings, Four Seasons Hotel Luxor offers a unique opportunity to be part of a landmark opening and help shape the future of luxury hospitality in one of the world's most captivating cultural destinations. The Role Of Director Of People And Culture Four Seasons Hotel Luxor is anticipated to open in 2027, and we are seeking a Director of People and Culture to join our team and help shape its future! This role reports to our General Manager, with a dotted reporting line to the Regional Director of People and Culture and will be responsible for leading the People, Culture and Learning strategy and execution for the Four Seasons Hotel Luxor; providing People and Culture support with the overall goal being that the hotel is perceived as the Employer of Choice in your destination. You will be the Cultural Advocate of the Golden Rule in every employee action in your hotel and responsibilities will include championing top talent and actively supporting succession planning, supporting the hotel as a Business Partner, fostering relationships with others as a coach, supporting and driving Corporate People and Culture initiatives, actively supporting recruitment, selection, onboarding and development requirements, evaluating the effectiveness of People and Culture programs and initiatives and analyzing compensation and benefits trends to ensure a balance between cost and employee experience. You will also be responsible for developing the learning quality and experience on property; delivering workplace learning and development, performance improvement programs, and initiatives to best achieve long-term business success. Our Ideal Director of People and Culture candidate will have: Passion for people, talent management and learning, combined with the ability to act as a trusted Business Partner; strategic, with strong business acumen, an understanding of operational needs, and the ability to contribute to key strategies and operational decisions for the hotel. A catalyst for change and an employee champion, with a minimum of three years of experience in a similar role, preferably within a luxury hospitality environment. Pre-opening experience is advantageous, along with strong knowledge and understanding of Egyptian labor law, employment regulations, social insurance and payroll compliance requirements. Experience interpreting and applying Egyptian labor legislation, maintaining productive relationships with government authorities and labor offices, familiarity with work permit and expatriate employment processes, and a proven ability to lead talent acquisition, succession planning, employee engagement, leadership development, workforce planning, and organizational change initiatives. A strategic approach to talent, learning and development, succession planning, and workforce effectiveness, with the ability to align people strategies with business objectives, support long-term organizational success, and contribute to positioning the hotel as the Employer of Choice. Fluency in Arabic and English is a must for this location, along with current eligibility to work in Egypt. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts can offer what many hospitality professionals dream of; the opportunity to build a life-long career with global potential and a real sense of pride in work well done. We look for talent who share the Golden Rule – people who, by nature, believe in treating others as we would have them treat us. As Four Seasons works towards phenomenal growth in the next decade, our most valuable partners continue to be our talent, with whom we have a strong relationship based on the Golden Rule. This relationship is made tangible by the awards received year after year by Four Seasons on a corporate level, as well as by our hotels, resorts and residences around the world, making us an undisputed “employer of choice.”

review_candidates.title: Product Lead (ERP)
review_candidates.description: We need a Product Lead who understands that ERP product management is not feature-list management. It is the discipline of saying no to customizations that fragment the product. You will own the product roadmap, define how the ERP's business logic should work, and act as the final gate on every customer-specific request. You will work directly with developers and implementation consultants, with no layers between you and the work. This is a builder role at a small, fast team where your decisions ship in weeks, not quarters. Responsibilities Own the product roadmap: what gets built, in what order, and what explicitly does not get built. Act as the scope gate: review every customer-specific request beyond standard configuration and issue a written decision. Define business logic for finance, inventory, and operations workflows. Developers implement your rules; they do not invent them. Run the weekly Product-Delivery Sync, converting implementation pain points into ranked product decisions. Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with the Technical Lead, balancing customer value against architectural integrity. Brief the Commercial Lead on what can and cannot be promised to prospects. Qualifications 4+ years in product management, with at least 2 in B2B software. ERP, CRM, or vertical SaaS strongly preferred. Real domain fluency in at least one of: finance and accounting, supply chain, manufacturing, or HR. Experience saying no to enterprise customers without losing them. Comfort working directly with developers and implementation consultants in a hands-on capacity. Strong written communication: you can turn a field complaint into a one-page product decision. How to Apply Read the requirements carefully before applying. To be considered, send your CV and a short note to ( info.egy@hispeed-erp.com ) with the role title in the subject line. Applications that do not address the listed qualifications will not be reviewed.

Key Responsibilities ▪ Monitor operational dependencies and workflows across different departments to identify potential risks, control gaps, and operational inefficiencies. ▪ Conduct gap analyses to assess existing processes against internal policies, procedures, and control requirements. ▪ Review, evaluate, and revise departmental workflows to ensure proper controls, accountability, and process efficiency. ▪ Assess operational risks across business functions and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. ▪ Conduct periodic reviews of operational processes to identify weaknesses, inconsistencies, and areas for improvement. ▪ Evaluate the effectiveness of existing internal controls and recommend enhancements where necessary. ▪ Coordinate with department heads and relevant stakeholders to understand operational processes and address identified gaps. ▪ Prepare risk assessment reports, document findings, and follow up on the implementation of corrective actions. ▪ Support the development and improvement of operational risk policies, procedures, and control frameworks. ▪ Monitor the implementation of agreed recommendations to ensure sustainable process improvements. Preferred Backgrounds ▪ Holding companies and their subsidiaries. ▪ Non-Banking Financial Institutions (NBFIs). ▪ Asset Management and Investment Firms. ▪ Banking and Financial Services.

Diakonia therefore strives to recruit staff with diverse backgrounds and lived experiences. Diakonia is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct; and committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults and beneficiaries with whom Diakonia engage. Diakonia expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our values are recruited to work for us. The post holder will undertake the appropriate level of training and is responsible for ensuring that they understand and work within the safeguarding policies of the organisation. All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records and terrorism finance checks. Diakonia also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants’ previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her understanding of these recruitment procedures PURPOSE OF THE POSITION To support MENA Gender Justice Program implementation and coordination, with focus on partners´ implementation and execution according to partner agreement, aligned with Diakonia’s global policies, strategies, order of delegation, code of conduct and other steering documents, as well as Diakonia´s feminist and human-rights based principles and our values of solidarity, justice, courage, commitment and accountability. The position is part of the regional multi-context program team led by the Program Director. The role requires a high degree of flexibility and strong teamwork skills. Follow up on partner actions and milestones, address delays, and ensure the quality and consistency of project documentation and deliverables. Monitor progress against approved work plans, indicators, results, and timelines; review partner reports, address gaps, and conduct project monitoring and evaluation visits. Ensure that the actions are planned, implemented, and managed with special consideration for gender, environment, and conflict sensitivity Support relationship building, collaboration and support to partner organizations in line with Diakonia’s partnership policy. Monitor and identify relevant funding opportunities and donor calls aligned with Diakonia’s priorities. Contribute to context analysis, program development and resource mobilization efforts, including identifying potential funding opportunities, and contributing to fundraising strategies. Draft concept notes and donor proposals in coordination with the Program Manager and Program Director. Support the Program Director in identifying relevant donor contacts and entry points and following up on funding opportunities. Maintain an updated donor and funding opportunity mapping, including deadlines, requirements, and follow-up actions. Coordinate the collection of required inputs from program, finance, and other relevant colleagues during proposal development. Support the preparation of donor meetings and presentations, including background notes and relevant documentation. Contribute to internal learning by documenting relevant donor trends, priorities, and lessons from submitted proposals. We want to see how you think, optimize, and create measurable business impact. Join Teddy Tech and help businesses turn marketing investments into meaningful growth.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description OnStar is a cornerstone of General Motors’ connected services—bringing safety, security, diagnostics, navigation, and convenience to customers through the mobile apps , website , and the in-vehicle experience , supported by a complex set of cloud services and integrations operating at global scale. To support this, we’re scaling our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization in Dublin, responsible for keeping the OnStar product line resilient, performant, and scalable for millions of customers. We are seeking an experienced engineer with a strong background in SRE, cloud operations, and project ownership to help build and improve reliability practices across our customer-facing OnStar experiences and the services behind them. What You’ll Be Doing Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant, and observable infrastructure supporting OnStar mobile and web experiences, in-vehicle services, and the backend platforms and integrations that power them. Drive adoption of configuration management, infrastructure refactoring, and testing frameworks to strengthen system resilience. Partner across SRE, development, and product teams to improve service reliability, deployment safety, and incident response practices. Provide consultation and contribute to planning on reliability standards for new OnStar capabilities, customer-facing releases, and platform initiatives. Help evolve and implement an observability approach using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog, with automated alerting and actionable SLO dashboards. Support and improve on-call practices, manage blameless postmortems, and guide root cause analysis to eliminate recurring failures. Mentor engineers and support a culture rooted in extreme ownership and operational excellence. Support compliance and privacy-driven engineering initiatives across connected services, with potential crossover into areas like data retention and safety certification tooling. What You Bring 6+ years in SRE, DevOps, or systems engineering, including experience mentoring engineers and leading project-level technical work. Track record of building and maintaining high-scale, cloud-native systems (preferably AWS, GCP, or Azure). Expertise in container orchestration and deployment strategies using Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines. Proficiency in Python, Go, or Java, with strong code review and readability standards. Experience leading cross-functional infrastructure projects, configuration strategy, or organizational tooling initiatives. Ability to think and act under pressure — whether debugging a live incident or balancing uptime vs cost trade-offs. Familiarity with privacy engineering, data security, or experience supporting compliance frameworks is a plus. Strong communication skills — able to influence, mentor, and lead across diverse technical teams. Why Join Us? This is more than an engineering role — it’s an opportunity to help deliver reliable connected experiences customers depend on. At GM, you’ll join a team committed to cutting-edge technology , sustainability , and inclusive innovation . With meaningful projects, a collaborative culture, and a global mission, your impact will be tangible and far-reaching—improving reliability across OnStar mobile apps, web experiences, in-vehicle services, and the systems behind them. Hybrid - This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to our Limerick office three times per week, at minimum [or other frequency dictated by the business]. Ready to lead reliability at scale? Join our SRE team in Dublin and help power trusted OnStar experiences for millions of customers. About GM Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. Why Join Us We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers. We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire . Accommodations General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

Coordinar de forma transversal equipos de negocio y tecnología. Liderar equipos y actuar como referente técnico/arquitecto en la toma de decisiones. Conocimiento en herramientas ETL (especialmente Talend). Conocimiento de Mulesoft (no necesariamente implementación directa, pero sí comprensión de su funcionamiento). Experiencia con herramientas de monitorización y logging (Datadog, Grafana u otras). Capacidad para diseñar y comunicar arquitecturas de integración. Experiencia en entornos de integración complejos y sistemas distribuidos. Nivel alto de inglés (B2–C1) para entornos internacionales. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Contrato indefinido Modelo de trabajo en remoto. Horario flexible: horario flexible entrada 8.30h salida 18h con viernes intensivo de 8h a 15h y en verano (julio y agosto) intensivo de 8h a 15h Vacaciones: 22 días de vacaciones + 2 días de libre disposición, además de los días 24 y 31 de diciembre libres. Contrato indefinido: Desde el primer día, con opción de 12 o 14 pagas. Retribución flexible: Tarjeta restaurante, cheque guardería, seguro médico, formación y otros beneficios con ventajas fiscales. Plan de carrera: Acompañamiento para crecer, especializarte o asumir nuevos retos. Bienestar integral: Programas de nutrición, actividad física y equilibrio emocional. Conciliación +VIDA: Asistencia personal y familiar 24/7. Ambiente inclusivo: Entorno diverso y multicultural. Eventos sociales: Actividades para conectar con el equipo.
